items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: We played Philadelphia for the first time and there I met Wilbur de Paris and told him that I had known him as a kid in Crawfordsville.

ctx.x: The medicine shows were always on at an early hour of the evening and Sidney started playing with Clarence Page at the open air pavillion where Dolly Jones had played. I heard Gabriel blow many times that summer.

Wilbur De Paris played with some orchestra in the Sterling Hotel, so I never heard him. Sidney didn't remember me going to the same school as he, but I did remember my cousin Theophilus Chenault and I became better acquainted with Sidney De Paris after I told him that Theophilus was my cousin.

I never heard the De Paris family play together but I was told that the mother, father and a sister of Sidney all played music. I don't know if there were more than one sister but there was only the two boys, Wilbur and Sidney.
